summary.text: Ron Estes is the Republican incumbent representing Kansas's 4th District since 2017, elected in a special election to succeed Mike Pompeo. A civil engineer by training who worked in consulting and management, he previously served as Sedgwick County Treasurer and Kansas State Treasurer. He chairs the Social Security subcommittee of the House Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Born in Topeka, Kansas, in 1956; according to his official biography he is a fifth-generation Kansan who grew up on his family farm.
Earned a bachelor's degree in civil engineering (1973) and a master's degree in business administration (1983) from Tennessee Technological University, per Ballotpedia.
Began his career in consulting and management roles in aerospace, energy and manufacturing industries, according to his official biography; also worked as a businessman and farmer.
Served as Sedgwick County Treasurer (2004-2010) and Kansas State Treasurer (2011-2017).
Won the April 11, 2017 special election to replace Mike Pompeo, who left Congress to become CIA director, defeating Democrat James Thompson and Libertarian Chris Rockhold.
In the 2025-2026 Congress he serves on the Ways and Means Committee (chairing its Social Security subcommittee), the Budget Committee, and the Joint Economic Committee.
According to his official biography, he has worked on tax reform, the farm bill, Wichita's aviation industry and Title X family planning guidelines, and supports military families and veterans.
